name: Zipline-Park Sölden
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Zipline Park in **Sölden** features five parallel zip lines up to **25 meters** high. If you're brave enough, you can soar side by side with friends in the **Duell-Modus** (duel mode) across the meadows of the **Ötztal** valley. A mandatory safety training beforehand builds confidence even for beginners.
